gen-eater-general-sans: Dark and snarling: Eater spreads its letters wide, thin strokes beside weightier stems. General Sans, a sans-serif with an x-height that fills the line, holds up fine at a modest size.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-rowan: Commanding up top, Cherry Swash curves a horseshoe-wide c and gives its diagonals the full heft of its verticals. Rowan feels friendly and literary as the lines pile up, its generous curves keeping the texture soft.
gen-gf-revalia-fs-paquito: Revalia strides across widely spaced letters, bold and expressive, with short stalks over a tall band. Paquito, a text serif whose lowercase nearly meets the caps, is happiest at a generous size.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-rowan: Rowan sets a lightly shaded, literary texture running through each word, thin strokes about half its thick ones. Then Shantell Sans, drawn with one fixed nib width, hands over to pages that feel warm and unhurried.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-rowan: Round, level and a bit stubborn, Sniglet keeps one weight throughout. Rowan, a text serif whose stroke weight swings only modestly, makes pages feel restful and friendly, each line easing into the next.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-paquito: Paquito brings a confident, approachable text serif, its lowercase nearly meeting the caps, beneath a stencil heading with wide bridges. Shrink Snowburst One or enlarge Paquito, and the heading loses its bite.
gen-gf-unica-one-fs-paquito: Unica One has an oversized lowercase eye, daylight showing in every curve, and uniform strokes. Paquito, a serif that closes the gap between lowercase and caps, gives that heading a confident, approachable partner.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-rowan: Loud and commanding, Unkempt keeps every curve at full weight. Rowan, the serif underneath, tempers its stroke contrast so the page gets friendly, literary calm without going flat after the shout.
gen-gf-grandstander-work-sans: Work Sans, contemporary and modern, keeps its c tips well apart beneath Grandstander, which has short ascenders and a tall x-height. Work Sans then reads steadily across paragraphs, its joins as sturdy as its strokes.
gen-gf-gugi-fs-public-sans: Hefty and trustworthy, Public Sans opens its counters broad on c and s beneath the tall, bold lettering of Gugi. Public Sans carries paragraphs forward steadily, leaving the showmanship to the heading.
